results.cau_hoi: Doanh thu theo từng danh mục sản phẩm
results.sql_sinh_ra:
SELECT 
    pc.Name AS ProductCategory,
    SUM(sd.LineTotal) AS TotalSales
FROM 
    Sales.SalesOrderDetail sd
JOIN 
    Sales.SalesOrderHeader soh ON sd.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
JOIN 
    Production.Product p ON sd.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN 
    Production.ProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
JOIN 
    Production.ProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
WHERE 
    soh.Status = 5
GROUP BY 
    pc.Name
ORDER BY 
    pc.Name;

    SUM(sh.SubTotal) AS TotalSales
FROM

WHERE

results.cau_hoi: Doanh thu theo danh mục sản phẩm quý 4 năm 2013
results.sql_sinh_ra:
SELECT 
    pc.Name AS ProductCategory,
    SUM(sd.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenue
FROM 
    Sales.SalesOrderHeader soh
JOIN 
    Sales.SalesOrderDetail sod ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID
JOIN 
    Production.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN 
    Production.ProductSubcategory psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = psc.ProductSubcategoryID

results.cau_hoi: Doanh thu theo từng tháng năm 2013
results.sql_sinh_ra:
SELECT 
    DATEPART(YEAR, OrderDate) AS Year,
    DATEPART(MONTH, OrderDate) AS Month,
    SUM(SubTotal) AS TotalSales
FROM 
    Sales.SalesOrderHeader
WHERE 
    Status = 5
    AND OrderDate >= '2013-01-01' 
    AND OrderDate < '2014-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    DATEPART(YEAR, OrderDate), 
    DATEPART(MONTH, OrderDate)
ORDER BY 
    Year, Month;

results.cau_hoi: Số đơn hàng theo từng quý năm 2012
results.sql_sinh_ra:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4'
    END AS Quarter,
    COUNT(SalesOrderID) AS NumberOfOrders
FROM 
    Sales.SalesOrderHeader
WHERE 
    OrderDate >= '2012-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2013-01-01'
    AND Status = 5
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4'
    END
ORDER BY 
    Quarter;

        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4'
    END AS Quarter,
    SUM(SubTotal) AS TotalRevenue
FROM 
    Sales.SalesOrderHeader
WHERE

    AND OrderDate >= '2013-01-01' 
    AND OrderDate < '2014-01-01'

        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3'
        WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4'
    END
ORDER BY
